EOGB is a leading manufacturer and distributor of oil, gas and dual fuel burners. EOGB burners are available in one stage, two stage and modulating modes, as well as low NOx variants. Our design and manufacture process ensures products adhere to ISO international quality standards. Outputs range from 17kW to 15MW, ideal for domestic, commercial and industrial applications.
